reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.

The cited covenant (Section 3.19, read with the 'Exclusive Period' and 'Competing Product' definitions) binds SFJ and its Affiliates (counterparty), so it operates in our favour and is correctly not flagged per the rule's detection guidance ('Restrictions binding the Vendor are fine').

The rationale accurately characterises Section 7.5.5 as a financing/consent covenant on Licensing Transactions (with an Excluded Licensing Transaction carve-out and a reasonableness limit on withholding consent) rather than a non-compete or field-of-use restriction, and correctly notes it under the negative-covenant rules instead of double-flagging the same term here.

No text cited restricts PB from developing, manufacturing or selling products or limits its field of use or territory, so the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer) is met and retaining this as internal compliance evidence is appropriate.
